new_categories.name: forensics
new_categories.definition: Digital/multimedia forensic evidence analysis for investigations: image/video authentication, redaction, mobile-data extraction and classification.

new_categories.name: threat_intel
new_categories.definition: Open-source / dark-web / extremist-community monitoring and cyber threat intelligence platforms (distinct from generic security tools).

new_categories.name: physical_security
new_categories.definition: Physical-world sensing and patrol hardware with onboard AI: surveillance towers, autonomous drones/robots, thermal/teraherz/concealed-object scanners, body-cam/EO-IR turrets.

new_categories.name: developer_tool
new_categories.definition: IDEs, query/admin tools, and scripting/SDK environments used by software engineers (distinct from coding_assistant LLM features).

new_categories.name: investigative_data
new_categories.definition: Public-records / people-search / risk-data platforms used for investigations, due diligence, and identity resolution (distinct from legal-research databases).
